text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived damaged. A snapped main stem would normally count as damaged on arrival, but that has to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, and at 3 days you're past that window.

You can still submit a claim under our Plant Care Guarantee, which covers 30 days from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members). Go to "My Orders" and upload at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. I can't promise it will be approved, since the guarantee covers plants that die or decline significantly despite reasonable care, and the specialist makes that decision. If approved, you'd get one free replacement.
